units: Gitt. 56ᵇ אתא פ׳ עליה מרומי a courier came for his sake from Rome and said, Rise, for they have elected thee Cæsar (Ar. a message).
<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:13">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>שדר עליה פ׳</he> he (the king) sent an orderly for him (summoning him to appear; Ms. M. <he>שדר קיסר קרייה</he>).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:4">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>שדרו פ׳ דמלכא בתריה</he> (Ms. M. <he>פ׳</he> only) they sent a policeman after him (to arrest him).

<cite ref="Ketubot 62a:7">Keth. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא חליף פ׳ דמלכא וכ׳</he> and a royal officer never passed his door (to molest him with execution &c.; Ar. <cite ref="D01072"><he>דְּרוּקָא</he></cite>).—Pl. <cite ref="Q01814"><he>פְּרִיסְתְּקֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Megillah 7a:18">Meg. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>דילמא פ׳ שדור</he> (Ms. O. <he>פ׳ דמלכא</he>) perhaps they sent word through orderlies; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1059:12">Yalk. Esth. 1059</cite> (sing.).—Hebr. form <cite ref="Q01941"><he>פְּרַסְתְּקִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:8">Gen. R. s. 41</cite> <he>ילך ויביא לו שני פ׳ מן וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>פרצתקין</he>) let him go and bring in two soldiers (common men) from the street and make them his heirs; Yalk. ib. 70.
